K-25's five distinct current direct offers total 2,195.5 m², split into office 1,826.5 m², office/meeting 115 m² and storage 254 m². This is a marketed subtotal only; it is not a campus-wide vacancy total or fitted-lab subtotal.

K-25 scope conflict remains: campus leasing table 4,300 m² versus direct letting page 6,300 m² total rental area. Existing occupiers and individual available units are identified, but the aggregate scopes are not reconciled.
K-141 currently markets office memberships but provides no quantified available private-office or coworking inventory. Its 8,048 m² aggregate and more than 100 occupiers are not a vacancy schedule.
K-141 operator floor menu includes 3. OG, while the owner's 8,048 m² table ends at 2. OG. No assumption is made that this adds available area.

K-410 timing conflict remains: dated owner article of 2026-09-17 and undated campus map describe refurbishment, while undated operator pages read on 2026-11-04 market turnkey ready-to-use labs. No dated completion or handover evidence resolves whether all, part or none of the aggregate is completed and unleased.

K-410's 3,100 m² is mixed laboratory/office area. Exact fitted-lab share, available module count, floor allocation and current vacant fitted-lab total remain unknown. The 6–45 m² range is a module-size range, not quantified inventory.

K-420 is associated with IOB on the owner map but has no verified street number, floor area or vacancy schedule in this targeted pass. Tenant presence is not proof of full letting or owner occupation.
Undated leasing/operator pages have retrievedDate 2026-11-04 and publishedDate null. Copyright years, availability headlines and upload-directory dates are not treated as publication or update dates.

The uploaded site-level available_m2=15,400 and K-410 available_m2=3,100 are retained as marketing aggregate observations, not promoted to confirmed current vacancy. Historical November 2025 brochure figures are not used as current vacancy.
Research stopped after one targeted primary-source resolution pass. No tenant-by-tenant vacancy audit or further confirmation campaign was undertaken.
